lyrics.text: 跨越亿万光年的微光，在夜樱枝头轻轻停驻
lyrics.sub_text: Starlight from light-years away rests upon night sakura boughs

lyrics.text: 每一次遥远的回响，都是宿命重逢的序章
lyrics.sub_text: Every distant echo writes the prelude of our reunion

lyrics.text: 循着银月铺展的轨迹，伸手触碰星海彼岸
lyrics.sub_text: Follow the silver-moon trail to touch the far shore of stars

lyrics.text: 当黎明染亮天际线，星辉仍守护着誓言
lyrics.sub_text: As dawn gilds the horizon, starlight still guards our vow
